interpretation.text: All 36 real IBus/GTK/X11 attempts delivered the late final insertFromComposition 7-15ms after the empty compositionend and before the Ctrl+Z keydown reached the DOM.
Key, early-Ctrl, pointer and stall variants up to 120ms did not reorder the commit behind Ctrl+Z; the commit appears to be flushed before later key events are delivered.
Whether any real native path can produce empty compositionend -> Ctrl+Z -> late final input; synthetic DOM events are not native proof.

decision: No additional bounded real-native trigger beyond the already-covered variants was identified; D2 remains INCONCLUSIVE and the composition/history policy is unchanged.
